name: pabrisson
description: Claude Code plugins from Pabrisson's config: mods, hooks, agents, commands and skills

plugins.name: mod-hud
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: model, effort, folder, branch, tool activity, usage bars, context, cost and updates

plugins.name: mod-ports
plugins.description: Right pane listing what runs for the project (Docker swarm and containers, Kubernetes, local processes) with its state, links and restart, toggled from the hud's icon

plugins.name: mod-code-fence
plugins.description: Wraps code pasted into the prompt in a ```lang fence, so md-prompt draws it as a code card

plugins.name: hook-notify
plugins.description: macOS notification when Claude finishes or waits for input, with each prompt's duration logged to SQLite (ccnotify)

plugins.name: agent-frontend
plugins.description: Agents frontend-developer (React, responsive, accessibility) and ui-ux-designer (user research, wireframes, design systems)

plugins.name: agent-backend
plugins.description: Agents backend-architect (APIs, microservices, DB schemas) and api-documenter (OpenAPI, SDKs, developer docs)

plugins.name: agent-review
plugins.description: Agent code-reviewer: quality, security and maintainability review

plugins.name: agent-prompt
plugins.description: Agent prompt-engineer: prompt optimization for LLMs and AI features

plugins.name: command-docs
plugins.description: Commands add-readme, add-changelog, update-docs, create-architecture-documentation, summarize-implementation

plugins.name: command-toolbox
plugins.description: Commands ultra-think (deep multi-dimensional analysis) and fork-sync (sync a fork with upstream)

plugins.name: skill-shadcn
plugins.description: Skill shadcn: add, search, fix, style and compose shadcn/ui components

plugins.name: skill-laravel
plugins.description: Skill laravel-upgrade: upgrade Laravel one major version at a time with test pauses

plugins.name: skill-find-skills
plugins.description: Skill find-skills: discover and install agent skills
